answer: Anchor each identity to a distinct live network endpoint the economy polls at random, like a jetty every boat alone must maintain. Clones sharing one backend are caught the way one harbor betrays many hulls: identical TLS fingerprints, IPs, and response rhythms across identities. Faking N separate backends costs nearly as much as running N real agents, like planting a whole cedar forest to hide one tree. An ocean of clones drains into a single detectable harbor, and the attack funds its own exposure.
